statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness
The patient has a history of documented supraventricular tachycardia
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm and assess for recurrent paroxysmal tachyarrhythmias
The diagnosis codes are R55 and I47.1
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
